image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent Ankylosaurus from the libraries.characters.dino_racer_ankylosaurus config at the victory ceremony. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Wide, squat frame; slate-grey dorsal armor; deep moss-green lower skin; pale cream-colored side spikes. Broad triangular head with four horns and amber eyes. Heavy bone tail club. ACTION: He is positioned directly behind a three-tier wooden victory podium. He is so wide he dwarfs the stand; his thick front feet are planted firmly on the 2nd and 3rd place tiers, while his head is lifted high over the center '1st Place' level. A bright red 'Winner' ribbon is draped over one of his upper head horns. TAIL: His massive tail club rests on the ground to the side, taking up significant space. FACIAL EXPRESSION: A stoic, heavy-lidded expression of quiet pride; a subtle, firm smirk. SETTING: The finish line ceremony area; LANCE_HELL_CREEK environment with lush ferns and palm-like flora. Blurred, cheering dinosaur spectators in the background. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3'. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC' with warm highlights on the stony armor. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' low-angle shot to emphasize his massive, tank-like presence.
